name: @pipeworx/mcp-sba-loans

tools.name: sba_loan_lookup
tools.description: Look up a small business's SBA 7(a) or 504 loan(s) by borrower name. Returns individual loan records: amounts, lender, approval date, status (P I F / PIF = paid in full, CHGOFF = charged off, CANCLD = cancelled, EXEMPT), and — for charged-off loans — the charge-off amount. Street addresses are never stored or returned (city/state/ZIP only). Scope to a state to disambiguate common business names.

borrower_name.description: Business or sole-proprietor name to search (substring match), e.g. "Ameripro Construction".

state.description: Two-letter state code to scope the search, e.g. "PA".

program.description: Optional: "7A" or "504". Omit to search both.

tools.name: sba_largest_loans
tools.description: Largest SBA 7(a)/504 loans, ranked by gross approval amount, filterable by program, NAICS code, borrower state, and/or lender name. Answers "what are the biggest SBA loans in NAICS X" or "largest SBA loans in Texas".

lender_name.description: Optional lender name substring, e.g. "Wells Fargo".

tools.name: sba_lender_league_table
tools.description: Lender league table — ranks lenders by SBA loan count and total dollar volume. For 7(a) loans "lender" is the originating bank; for 504 loans it is the CDC (Certified Development Company) that books the debenture. Answers "which bank does the most SBA lending in NAICS Y" or "top SBA 504 lenders in California".

program.description: Optional: "7A" or "504". Omit to combine both (note: 7(a) banks and 504 CDCs are different kinds of entity, so combining programs mixes those populations).

tools.name: sba_charge_off_aggregate
tools.description: Charge-off rate and dollar amount, aggregated by NAICS code, state, lender, or program. Answers "which industries have the highest SBA loan charge-off rate" or "charge-off amount by state". charge_off_rate is charged-off loan COUNT divided by total loan count in that group (not dollar-weighted).

group_by.description: One of: naics | state | lender | program (default naics).

program.description: Optional: "7A" or "504" to scope before grouping.

state.description: Optional 2-letter borrower state code to scope before grouping.

naics_code.description: Optional 6-digit NAICS code to scope before grouping.

tools.name: ppp_loan_lookup
tools.description: Look up a business's Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) loan(s) by borrower name. Returns each loan's approved amount, jobs_reported (the headcount the business stated on its 2020-21 application), NAICS code, servicing and originating lender, approval date, first or second draw, loan status, and forgiveness amount and date. Names match from their first word ("Sumter Coatings" finds "SUMTER COATINGS, INC."); add zip to also match a word inside the name. Business borrowers only: sole proprietors, self-employed individuals and borrowers named as a person are excluded, and no street address is stored. Source: SBA PPP FOIA data, as of 2024-09-30.

borrower_name.description: Business name, from its first word, e.g. "Sumter Coatings". Suffixes like Inc/LLC and punctuation are ignored.

state.description: Optional 2-letter borrower state code to narrow common names, e.g. "SC".

zip.description: Optional 5-digit borrower ZIP. With it, a word inside the name also matches.

tools.name: ppp_aggregate
tools.description: Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) totals grouped by NAICS industry code, borrower state, or servicing lender: loan count, total approved, loans and dollars forgiven, forgiveness rate, and total jobs reported. Optionally scoped to one borrower state. Answers "which industries got the most PPP money in Texas" or "which lenders serviced the most PPP dollars". Business borrowers only (sole proprietors and individuals excluded). Source: SBA PPP FOIA data, as of 2024-09-30.

state.description: Optional 2-letter borrower state code to scope before grouping.

order_by.description: Rank by total approved amount (default), loan count, or jobs reported.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sba-loans forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sba-loans pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
